There are no additional unrelated changes that violate the scope or ticket request.

The diff for PMAT-4127 strictly and faithfully fulfills the ticket requirements:
1. Bumps `tabled` from 0.16 to 0.22 in `crates/apr-cli/Cargo.toml`, which upgrades `tabled_derive` to 0.12.0 and eliminates the dependency on `proc-macro-error` (RUSTSEC-2024-0370).
2. Bumps `validator` from 0.20 to 0.21 in `crates/aprender-train/Cargo.toml` and `crates/aprender-simulate/Cargo.toml`, moving `validator_derive` to 0.20.1 in `Cargo.lock` which replaces unmaintained `proc-macro-error2` (RUSTSEC-2026-0173) with `proc-macro-error3`.
3. Removes both advisory exemptions (RUSTSEC-2024-0370 and RUSTSEC-2026-0173) from `deny.toml`.
